jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.empty: Nothing has run yet. Once you start an import or a send, you'll find it here.
jobs.description: Work running in the background: contact imports and campaign audience builds.
jobs.refreshHint: While something is running, the list refreshes itself. Otherwise use the button.
jobs.refreshFailed: The list could not be refreshed. Showing the last loaded state.
jobs.unknownTotal: The total is still being counted
jobs.stoppingNote: Stopping: the batch in progress still finishes, so the numbers may move a little.
jobs.cancelImportKept: Contacts imported so far stay in the project: {done} of {total} rows.
jobs.cancelImportNothingYet: No contact has been written yet, so nothing will be added to the project.
jobs.cancelImportRest: The rest of the file will not be imported. The import result page has a Continue button that picks up where it stopped.
jobs.cancelImportBatch: The import stops at the next check, so the batch in progress still finishes.
jobs.cancelCampaignWhole: Stopping cancels the whole campaign. There is no way to prepare the audience and leave the campaign waiting.
jobs.cancelCampaignQueued: Messages already queued are removed and will not reach anyone.
jobs.cancelCampaignCopy: Campaign content and contacts are not deleted. A cancelled campaign cannot be restarted though, a new attempt means a copy.
jobs.cancelCampaignAck: I understand the whole campaign is cancelled and cannot be restarted.
jobs.cancelRequested: Stop requested. The job stops at the next check, the batch in progress still finishes.
jobs.cancelAlreadyFinished: The job finished in the meantime, so there is nothing to stop.
jobs.workerNeverSeen: Not seen yet. Either the installation has not started up, or the job queue could not be read.
jobs.workerQueues: Queues in this installation: {registered}. {scheduled} of {expected} cron queues tick on schedule.
jobs.workerCronWithoutHandler: {count, plural, =0 {No queue is} one {One queue is} other {# queues are}} left without a handler in this build, so they are deliberately not scheduled.
jobs.workerAttention: Something is not being processed on its own. Jobs set aside have used up every retry and nobody will pick them up; your installation administrator can decide what happens to them.
jobs.workerFailedNote: Failures are counted over the last {hours} hours, not the whole history. Older failures that have since been fixed are not included.
